events.headline: September CPI accelerates to 3.7% y/y (core 2.6%) on surging energy/gasoline costs, released Oct 14; raises odds Fed hikes again at Oct 27-28 meeting instead of holding
AI chip stocks lose ~$1.64T in value over six sessions; Nvidia, AMD, Micron hit by AI-financing/debt-sustainability worries (CoreWeave slump) and weak SK Hynix reaction
Intel and AMD shares slip premarket Oct 16 after Nvidia unveils new PC processor competing directly in the PC chip market
Massive Russian missile/drone attack on Ukraine (Oct 14) kills at least 9, damages power infrastructure, cuts electricity to over half a million people in Kyiv
Zelensky says Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries ("We've had enough"), adding to Russian export-capacity disruption as Ukraine-US tensions rise over Patriot/Starlink support
Brent crude trading around $105-108/bbl this week, elevated on Middle East tensions and Russia/Venezuela sanctions dynamics
